title: A Controlled Comparison of Deep Learning Architectures for Multi-Horizon Financial Forecasting: Evidence from 918 Experiments
abstract: arXiv:2603.16886v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reliable comparison of deep learning architectures for financial forecasting requires controlled evaluation that separates architectural effects from hyperparameter tuning, random initialization, forecast horizon, and asset characteristics. We present a five-stage benchmark using equal-budget Bayesian hyperparameter optimization, category-level configuration freezing, three-seed final training, held-out metric aggregation, and rank-based statistical validation. Nine architectures from Transformer, MLP/linear, convolutional, and recurrent families are evaluated with direct multi-step prediction from five OHLCV features across 12 assets (four cryptocurrency, four foreign exchange, four equity-index instruments), using chronological 70/15/15 splits of 30,000 hourly windows per asset at 4- and 24-hour horizons. translated_title: 深度学习架构在多时间跨度金融预测中的受控比较：来自918个实验的证据
translated_abstract: 摘要：对用于金融预测的深度学习架构进行可靠比较，需要受控的评估方式，将架构本身的影响与超参数调优、随机初始化、预测时间跨度和资产特性等因素分离。我们提出了一个五阶段基准测试框架，采用等预算贝叶斯超参数优化、类别级配置冻结、三种子最终训练、留出指标聚合以及基于排名的统计验证。该基准评估了来自Transformer、MLP/线性、卷积和循环网络四大类别的九种架构，基于五个OHLCV特征进行直接多步预测，覆盖12种资产（四种加密货币、四种外汇、四种股指类工具），每种资产使用30,000个小时级窗口按时间顺序以70/15/15划分数据集，并在4小时和24小时两种预测跨度上进行测试。该基准测试共包含918次运行（270次优化试验，648次最终训练运行）。在24个资产-跨度组合点上，Modern
tldr: 本研究构建了一个包含918个受控实验的五阶段基准框架，在控制超参数、随机初始化、预测跨度和资产特性等因素的前提下，系统比较了Transformer、MLP、卷积和循环网络等九种深度学习架构在12种金融资产、4小时和24小时两种预测跨度下的表现。
en_tdlr: This study presents a controlled five-stage benchmark comprising 918 experiments that systematically compares nine deep learning architectures from Transformer, MLP, convolutional, and recurrent families across 12 financial assets at 4-hour and 24-hour forecast horizons, isolating architectural effects from hyperparameter tuning and other confounding factors.
